title: Opens and quasi-compact opens of a cofiltered limit of topological spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the description of the topology of a cofiltered limit of spaces (author lemma at source lines 2590-2601, label lemma-describe-limits): every open of the limit is a union of projection-preimages of opens, and every quasi-compact open is a single projection-preimage. The proof (source lines 2603-2642) computes with the standard basis of the product topology: it observes that only finitely many factors of a basis element can be proper, writes the intersection with the limit as a finite intersection of projection-preimages, and then uses quasi-compactness to collapse the finite union in the second assertion (proof lines 2604-2641). The distinction between arbitrary and quasi-compact opens is the point of the lemma and is what the later results on limits of spectral spaces use. H2.
